faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Glen of Imaal Terrier?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 32-40 lb (14.5-18 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Glen of Imaal Terrier?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Progressive retinal atrophy (PRA); Hip dysplasia; Allergies. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Glen of Imaal Terrier default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
